content:
ashwin: Canary fenris12b-int4 started hitting allocation stalls and a couple cuda OOMs at 80-120 token bursts. Pattern after quant flip.

liz: Any logs?

ashwin: Snippet: `ERROR inference: cudaMemAlloc OOM model=fenris12b variant=int4 host=gpu-12 max_new_tokens=256 batch=8 kv_cache=3.6GB`

carmen: Prefetch + high batch + large max_new_tokens spikes transient memory. Quick fix: disable prefetch and cap batches.

nora: Agreed. Also a small runtime change to free idle KV shards helps.

liz: Plan: roll canary config -> max_new_tokens=128, batching.max_batch_size=4, prefetch=false; enable feature kv_aggressive_free for pool.

ashwin: Starting rollout now.

deploy-bot: deploy 4972220001-config-rollout started for pool=fenris-fenris12b-canary by ashwin.

ashwin: 15m check: tail latency normalized, no new OOMs seen in canary for 30m.

carmen: PR opened with runtime patch to free zero-ref KV shards on checkpoint (canary-only flag).

nora: Kicked off quick-quality eval; will abort if longform F1 drops >2%.

liz: Add temporary console alert for fenris12b.canary.oom_rate to monitor.

ashwin: If stable overnight we propose new model defaults and a follow-up ticket to revisit kernel heuristics for int4 attention.
